question: In a certain code language, ‘CRUST’ is written as ‘201921183’ and ‘BLAME’ is written as ‘5131122’. How will ‘PLASTIC’ be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

The logic followed here is :

 
• **Positional**** value of the letters is written in the reverse order according to English alphabetic series.**
 
• Two digit positional values of letters according to English alphabetic series remains same within the number.

So,

 
• ‘CRUST’ is written as ‘201921183’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/de85a95496242a8e8bd0adbfd7384872ae3cf7e82d5aaf02593ba1ff8907a469.png] ​

And,

 
• ‘BLAME’ is written as ‘5131122’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d61f56770ae6fbef066035c20b069d0692edf93cfc74ae767a7b60e94b82f65b.png] ​

​Similarly,

 
• ‘PLASTIC’ is written as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6b8a5ad82b5d16a5a60c784e9173364b9021d81ff1e910a7701472a6fe33c5ab.png] ​

​Hence, **"39201911216"** is the correct answer.
